turns.question: What was the median site session duration in minutes between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: there is no session duration or median metric, so I can't give a median session length. The closest metrics are site_sessions (site sessions with a page view), cart_sessions, checkout_sessions, view_to_cart_rate and cart_to_checkout_rate.
